parameters.query: SELECT t.id AS tid, t.code, t.name AS tname, t.status, DATE_FORMAT(t.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date, DATE_FORMAT(t.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS end_date, (t.organizer_user_id = viewer.id) AS is_owner, viewer.id AS viewer_id, t.fixtures_published_at AS published_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_matches m WHERE m.tournament_id = t.id) AS match_count, m.id AS match_id, m.division_id AS match_division, m.status AS match_status, m.home_entry_id, m.away_entry_id, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(e.id) FROM tournament_entries e WHERE e.division_id = m.division_id AND e.status = 'APPROVED') AS division_entries FROM tournaments t JOIN app_users viewer ON viewer.phone = $1 LEFT JOIN tournament_matches m ON m.tournament_id = t.id AND m.id = $3 WHERE t.code = $2
